{{Top|leg}}
The '''ImpDoc Export Unrestricted list''' was a list of creatures that were not subject to restrictions on their exportation. Towards the end of the [[Rawmat shortage of 1–2 ABY|shortage]] of [[List of phrases and slang/Legends#R|rawmats]], [[Mining/Legends|miners]] working at the many new mines opened to meet the demand the shortage created sought pets on this list, among other items, to ease the isolation of their new posts.
